-- message --
pricing: pull the GST calculation into its own function
-- expect --
low+
-- note --
Mechanical, but in pricing code, so the payments rule may set Medium.
-- base/internal/format/money.go --
package format

import "fmt"

// Price formats cents with GST as dollars.
func Price(cents int64) string {
	withGST := cents + cents/10
	return fmt.Sprintf("$%d.%02d", withGST/100, withGST%100)
}
-- head/internal/format/money.go --
package format

import "fmt"

// Price formats cents with GST as dollars.
func Price(cents int64) string {
	withGST := addGST(cents)
	return fmt.Sprintf("$%d.%02d", withGST/100, withGST%100)
}

func addGST(cents int64) int64 { return cents + cents/10 }
